C1657.title: Shadow APIs Exploited in Optus Telecom Incident to Leak Personally Identifiable Information
C1657.summary: In December 2022, security analysis revealed that the techniques used in the Optus Telecom incident closely mirrored common shadow API risks found in customer environments.
